result:
These queries are written from the documentation page alone and have not been run. A few steps rest on assumptions about the language:
- `at` and `coalesce` treat a null subject the way they treat a missing key.
- `groupBy` accepts a string key and converts it to a keyword.
- `split ", "` removes the pair separators in O12, since the page lists no trim verb.
- `lines` may leave an empty last line, so I filter blank lines out where it could matter.
- `parseJson` is how I read numbers out of strings in O10 and O12.

O1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum
O2: filter ~(/status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/region) * count
O3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
O4: filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) * (/assignee/login | lower) | distinct | sort
O5: :p / | /dependencies | union (p | /devDependencies) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort
O6: filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * {:id /id :name /name :email (at :email)}
O7: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | ne false) | filter ~(at :port | ne null) * [(/name | keyword) /port] | tag ::map
O8: /data/items | filter ~(/type | eq "click") | filter ~(at :duration_ms | ne null) * /duration_ms | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 2
O9: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count | entries * {:path (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /path]) | take 2
O10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) * {:dept /1 :sal (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~(/dept) * (/ * /sal | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 1)
O11: lines | filter ~(contains "==") * (split "==" | /0 | lower) | sort | join ","
O12: split ", " * (split ":") * {:k (/0 | lower) :n (/1 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~(/k) * (/ * /n | sum)
O13: * /items | flat | groupBy ~(/sku) * (/ * /qty | sum) | entries * {:sku (/0 | keyword) :qty /1} | sort ~([(/qty | desc) /sku]) | take 3
O14: filter ~(/state | eq "closed") | every ~(at :assignee | ne null)
